question_text: Was the Lloyds Bank app outage a cyberattack?
answer_text: Nobody has said either way. Lloyds says some customers had difficulty accessing its app on Nov 27 and it is working to fix it, but gives no cause. Error messages spoke of technical problems, and no one has said it was an attack.
label: Not established
what_would_settle_it: Lloyds Banking Group, a regulator or another official source saying what caused the outage.

question_text: Which banks were hit by the Lloyds app outage?
answer_text: Lloyds Bank and Bank of Scotland, both part of Lloyds Banking Group. Customers of both reported problems with the app and online banking on the morning of Nov 27.
label: Confirmed

question_text: Is the Lloyds app working again?
what_would_settle_it: Lloyds Banking Group or its service status page saying the app and online banking are working again.

question_text: Was any Lloyds customer data or money affected?
what_would_settle_it: Lloyds Banking Group saying whether any customer data or payments were affected.

question_text: What can Lloyds customers do while the app is down?
answer_text: The bank suggested clearing the browser cache and history and reinstalling the app. Some customers got in through the website or a different browser, though not everyone.
label: Reported
